text:
Maya Patel: quick check on the 'Connectivity checks' panel for the Private setup wizard. Pushed a compact layout in Figma (link) 517. main goals: make failures actionable, avoid overwhelming infra teams, and keep it keyboard-friendly. can you skim?
Alex Chen: glanced. general thought: the vertical list with full-width chips feels heavy on small screens. could we do a responsive 2-column grid for status + short message, then expand details on click? also copy: 'Open ports' => 'Ports must be reachable' or 'Ensure reachability to the following ports'.
Jordan Lee: keyboard and screen reader notes: each check needs a clear role and label, e.g., role="group" with aria-labelledby, and the expand/collapse should be Enter/Space. add aria-live="polite" for the preflight progress bar so AT users hear updates.
Samir Rao: from infra ops POV: include quick diagnostics and one-click copy for commands, plus a small "test from this node" curl snippet. show an obfuscated example so people replace the host. e.g.:
```
curl -sS -I https://<control-plane-ip>:443 --max-time 5
```
and for etcd health:
```
curl -sS http://<node-ip>:2379/health --max-time 5
```
Maya Patel: nice. UX question: should passed checks collapse by default and only show failures expanded? reduces noise but some customers want to scroll through everything. maybe add a toggle "Show only failures" and default to collapsed.
Alex Chen: +1 for toggle. microcopy: the short reason under each failed check should be a 1-line explanation + a link to expanded steps. e.g., 'Connection timed out  Why this matters'. keep the tooltip one sentence.
Jordan Lee: for color/contrast: chips currently use light green (#4caf50) with dark text which fails AA in dark theme. use filled chips with white text OR add iconography (check/warn/error) and a 1px outline to help colorblind users. also include an accessible status text node that reads 'Check: DNS - failed' so screen readers are explicit.
DesignBot: automated lint: success-chip contrast ratio 3.2:1 in dark theme 6a7. recommended adjustments: darker fill or white label.
Samir Rao: operational caveat: do NOT offer automated firewall changes. instead provide suggested iptables/nft rules and cloud console quick links. sample iptables snippet for docs: 
```
# allow HTTPS and etcd (restrict source CIDR to control plane)
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s <control-plane-cidr> --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s <control-plane-cidr> --dport 2379 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s <control-plane-cidr> --dport 2380 -j ACCEPT
```
add a visible warning: 'Avoid 0.0.0.0/0 except during temporary debugging.'
Maya Patel: UX for diagnostics: each failed check should show a 'Copy command' button, a small 'Open provider guide' link (AWS/GCP/Azure), and an optional 'Run again' action. primary CTAs on the preflight page: left = 'Validate & Run' (primary), right = 'Skip & Continue' (secondary, with a confirmation). label for primary: 'Validate & Run' with tooltip 'Runs connectivity, DNS, MTU, and service checks.'
Alex Chen: wording alternatives for the page header: 'Network & deployment prerequisites' vs 'Connectivity checks for Private deployments'. prefer the latter for clarity. short subtitle: 'Quick checks to verify your network and node connectivity.'
Jordan Lee: also add focus management when a check expands (move focus into the panel), and ensure trap focus if modal appears. document keyboard shortcuts in a small help area.
Maya Patel: ok action list from this thread: 1) change copy to 'Ensure ports are reachable' + update header to 'Connectivity checks for Private deployments'. 2) responsive 2-col grid + collapse passed checks by default with 'Show all' toggle. 3) add copy buttons for diagnostics, provider quick links, and one-line iptables examples (no auto-fix). 4) address contrast errors (DesignBot) and add icons + aria-live + explicit status text. 5) button text -> 'Validate & Run' and add tooltip. I'll update Figma and submit a PR with a11y notes.
Samir Rao: please include the 'limit CIDR' warning in the PR and add example provider console links. also log telemetry event when users click 'Skip & Continue' so support can follow up.
Maya Patel: got it. will ping when mock and PR are ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
